subject: gk
question: For the development of agriculture, a new department, Diwan-i-Amir-Kohi was established by which of the following Sultans of Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Bin Tughlaq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Diwan-i-Amir-Kohi** was a special department established by Muhammad Bin Tughlaq for the development of agriculture.
 
• This department was responsible for improving agricultural practices and increasing crop production by providing state support to farmers.
 
• Muhammad Bin Tughlaq focused on expanding cultivation by introducing new irrigation systems and granting loans to farmers.
 
• The initiative aimed to improve food security and stabilize the economy during his reign.
 
• Despite ambitious efforts, many of Muhammad Bin Tughlaq's agricultural reforms faced challenges due to poor implementation and lack of local support.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Bin Tughlaq:** He ruled from 1325 to 1351 and was known for his ambitious projects and administrative innovations.
 
• **Diwan-i-Amir-Kohi:** This department was specifically created to oversee agricultural reforms and ensure efficient administration in rural areas.
 
• **Irrigation Systems:** Muhammad Bin Tughlaq introduced canal irrigation and other water management techniques to support agriculture.
 
• **Agricultural Loans:** Loans were provided to farmers under state supervision to encourage cultivation of barren lands.
 
• Many reforms failed due to excessive taxation, lack of proper implementation, and resistance from farmers.
